title: Outdoor Floor Tiles in Pakistan: Terracotta, Otti, Pavers
excerpt: Compare terracotta, concrete otti, paver and sandstone outdoor floor tiles for Pakistan: grip, drainage, base and what to ask before ordering.
meta_title: Outdoor Floor Tiles in Pakistan: Options Compared
meta_description: Terracotta, otti, paver and stone outdoor floor tiles compared for Pakistan's sun and rain: grip, base, drainage and what to ask. Free sample.
answer_box: Outdoor floor tiles in Pakistan should grip when wet, cope with sun and rain, and sit on a well-drained base. Terracotta, concrete otti, pavers and sandstone each suit different areas. Choose by use, test a wet sample and ask for a dated written quote stating the unit.
ai_summary: Outdoor floor tiles for Pakistani homes include terracotta, concrete otti, paver-style pieces and natural sandstone, each suited to patios, porches, paths or driveways. Grip, thickness and a drained base matter more than the brand. Pak Clay Tiles, in Lahore since 1982, offers a free WhatsApp sample and a dated quote.

faqs.question: Which outdoor floor tiles are best in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: No single tile is best. Terracotta suits patios, otti and pavers suit larger paved areas, and thicker pavers suit driveways. Match the material to the use and check a sample.

faqs.question: How much do outdoor floor tiles cost in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Prices depend on material, thickness, size, quantity, delivery and season, and may be quoted per piece, per square foot or per thousand. Ask for a written quote with the unit and date; Pak Clay replies with one on request.

faqs.question: Are terracotta tiles better than otti or pavers outdoors?
faqs.answer: Not in general. Terracotta gives a warm natural look but is porous, while otti and pavers lay quickly over larger areas. Compare samples for your area.

faqs.question: How do I stop outdoor tiles being slippery?
faqs.answer: Choose a textured face, lay with a slight fall so water drains, and keep shaded areas free of moss. Test a wet sample before ordering.
